scope: GATE Computer Science and Information Technology question-paper sources, 1996 through 2025
item_count_convention: For 1996-2002, expected_item_count expands legacy MCQ sub-question labels and counts each numbered descriptive parent once. printed_top_level_count preserves the paper's outer numbering, while split_database_record_count is separate and remains null until every lettered descriptive part is audited. From 2003 onward, expected_item_count counts canonical exam items; booklet-code reorderings are not separate papers.

authority_legend.secondary_mirror_of_original: Non-official host or user-supplied copy that visually reproduces the original paper.
authority_legend.secondary_republication: Re-typeset or republished question paper; every equation, figure, option, and key requires visual cross-checking.
authority_legend.secondary_compilation: A container combining sessions, papers, and/or answer keys from secondary distribution.
authority_legend.unresolved: No valid complete source is currently available locally.
